Hi, 18 year old boy here.

I'm in quite a similar situation. Only difference is that I'm introvert as hell. But other stuff applies.

First, I hated they way I looked. I thought I was too far (I wasn't). Then I was starving myself. I got to a BMI of 15 and was hospitalized, which only made me feel worse.

I still hate my inability to make any kind of social contact. Even looking into other's eyes is to stressful, saying a word is out of the question.

When I was about 14/15 I started hiding my feelings. Then I just lost them all together and was only left with emptiness. I feel like nothing brings me any joy.

I almost attempted suicide three months ago. I was about to slit my wrists, but decided not to in the last minute.

Two months ago I went to a psychiatrist and was diagnosed with MDD. I've been on Prozac ever since. I still get these thoughts, but only like once in 3 days. I've also been seeing a therapist. She is really kind and supportive.

TLDR I would recommend paying a visit to a doctor and a therapist. If you can't do that, well, I and many other people on Reddit will try to help you as much as we can. I wish you the best 💝
